description: May 22 birthday meaning: Taurus or Gemini cusp, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, May 22 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Taurus or Gemini. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: May 22 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 22nd of May carries master number 22, left unreduced, and one of the most debated cusp positions. Most years the Sun sits in the opening degrees of Gemini, but the sign depends on year and time. Master builder meets messenger: the combination is traditionally read as someone who can explain big plans clearly enough that others want to help construct them.

On May 22 the Sun usually sits at about 1° Gemini, in the first decan, where Mercury rules the decan as well as the sign. The cusp of Taurus and Gemini, around May 20 and 21, is where a fixed earth sign hands over to a mutable air sign. The changeover happens at a particular minute, and that minute varies with the year, so your actual Sun sign depends on when and where you were born. Checking a calculated chart removes the guesswork. Those who feel both energies often describe a grounded mind that also loves variety: someone who enjoys conversation and new ideas but wants them to lead somewhere tangible, preferably with a good meal along the way.

sections.heading: May 22 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 22 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33.

sections.heading: Born on May 22: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 22 is the 142nd day of the year (143rd in a leap year). By June 22, 31 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Cancer.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 22, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 22 include Richard Wagner (1813), Arthur Conan Doyle (1859) and Laurence Olivier (1907).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 22?
faq.answer: May 22 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Taurus or Gemini on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Gemini. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 22 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 22?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 22 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 22?
faq.answer: May 22 is also the birthday of Richard Wagner (1813), Arthur Conan Doyle (1859) and Laurence Olivier (1907). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
